aboutCards.title: Where I'm From
aboutCards.body: I was born and raised in St. Louis, MO. My dad is a medical salesman and my mom runs an idependent bookstore. We are a big DIY family, and I grew up building and tinkering, from building treehouses to rebuilding our lawnmower engine. I also spent many summers at my grandparent's farm where I learned to love nature, put in an honest day's work, and get vehicles stuck in the mud.

aboutCards.title: What I Used to Do
aboutCards.body: When I was 12 I passed out flyers and started mowing lawns. I saved enough to upgrade my equipment and expand, and did that every weekend through high school. After graduating from college I made pretty slide decks as an investment banker for a few years and got pretty good at Excel.

aboutCards.title: What I'm Looking For
aboutCards.body: After working with people building businesses I decided I wanted to do that instead of selling them. So I left banking, travelled the world for 8 months, and moved up to NYC to find an exciting company to help run from the inside.

aboutCards.title: In My Free Time
aboutCards.body: When I'm not working, you can usually find me running, trying new restaurants, and adventuring in new places with good friends.

aboutCards.title: Things I Value
aboutCards.body:
Being kind to people, especially when it is not easy
Individuality
Treating my mind and body well
Lifelong learning and self-improvement
Humility
Doing hard things
Improving the lives of others
Spending quality time with family + friends
Mental and physical adventure: Seeking growth and new experiences
Optimism
Finding peace in my mind and the world around me
Individual responsibility as an antidote to collective action problems
Simplicity
Connecting with people who are different from me
Getting out of my comfort zone
Maintaining perspective & touching grass
